resources.string: Receives available MODE events and shows CarMode. Diagnostics record key codes and OEM window metadata. Enable the service manually, then choose HCN MODE or KeyEvent learning in the app.
CarMode: select with the MODE button
MODE → next card → 2 seconds without pressing → launch. Always starts with the camera.
Startup makes MODE ready in the background without opening this screen. Grant permissions after the first launch. Your firmware may require its own startup permission.
Confirm that you pressed MODE. Only this key will be intercepted.
The test button runs the assigned action after 2 seconds. Press again to select the next card.
Defaults: camera ivicar.cn.ivicaravm; Music and Maps com.zjinnova.zlink. Apps launch directly, without automation. Android Auto section switching is not implemented yet.

Run the three labelled tests below, stop diagnostics and share the JSON file. Event files retain about 512 KiB; session summaries are stored separately. Keyboard codes, OEM window titles and technical metadata are included.
Recording is on, but key and window events need Accessibility

Finds the installed com.hcn.autosource app, copies its APK to the CarMode cache and opens Share. Multiple APK parts are packed into one ZIP. Does not modify the original app or copy its private data. Root, Accessibility and storage permission are not required; the firmware must allow reading the APK.
com.hcn.autosource was not found or is not visible to CarMode on this device.
Could not copy the APK. Reading may be blocked, the app may have updated, or storage may be full. Original files were not changed. Details: %1$s
Could not open sharing for the APK/ZIP. Check that a file-sharing app is installed.
Could not copy the log to the clipboard
Long press to select text. The button copies all the text below; export to share the complete saved log.
No app available to share JSON
This settings screen is unavailable on your firmware

Accessibility: %1$s
Display over other apps: %2$s
MODE: %3$s
Interception: %4$s
Key and window recording: %5$s
Learning: press MODE, then confirm the detected key.\nCandidate: %1$s
KeyEvent learning is off. HCN MODE does not require learning.
Allow CarMode to display over other apps
Could not show the menu. See the log for details.
Activity is disabled, not exported or requires a permission

OEM window diagnostics: immediate snapshots, retries after 50/150 ms, then every 250 ms for 20 seconds. Includes window metadata, accessible elements and app transitions. Missing Android events cannot be recovered by the logger.

Park before testing. Each test: 5-second countdown, three 2-second prompts, then 5 seconds of observation. Press once per prompt; in the no-press test do not touch anything. Use the same other steering-wheel button throughout its test. The banner stays over other apps. CarMode passes keys through during tests. Afterwards stop diagnostics and export. All delivered KeyEvents are logged, even outside recording; avoid typing private data while this Accessibility service is enabled.

Optional: connect a physical USB/Bluetooth keyboard before starting this test. After the countdown, press and release Right Arrow (→) once per prompt, three times total; do not press steering-wheel buttons. An on-screen keyboard is not suitable. The log includes the input device list and all delivered KeyEvents. A detected device alone does not prove event delivery.
Allow display over other apps. HCN tests need the background service; keyboard/KeyEvent tests need connected Accessibility.
Do not press yet. Starting in %1$d…
Control test: do not press. %1$d s
Test complete. KeyEvent callbacks: %1$d (not a physical press count).
onKeyEvent calls since process start: %1$d (0 = no calls observed).
Warning: other services request key filtering: %1$s. This alone does not prove a conflict.

Cancel the test and delete the displayed and saved logs, session history and cached export? This cannot be undone. Settings and files already shared are kept. If recording is on, it continues in a new session.

HCN MODE uses the background service and overlay permission; Accessibility is NOT required. Keep the CarMode background notification active. Accessibility is only needed for KeyEvent learning and window inspection. AUX autokey is only logged. Turn Handle MODE off to disable interception. Public broadcasts cannot authenticate physical presses.
HCN receiver unavailable — enable Handle MODE or start diagnostics and check background service status.
No HCN signal received since service connection.

Last channel: %1$s
Ordered: %2$s · Delivery aborted: %3$s
%4$s
Confirm on the head unit that the stock menu did not appear.

All guided tests are passive: KeyEvent and HCN signals reach stock apps. To test the replacement, finish/cancel the test and key learning, enable Control HCN MODE, then press MODE 1, 2 or 3 times (less than 2 seconds apart). Wait 2 seconds after the last press. Ordinary log recording does not disable replacement. Export the log even if onKeyEvent stays at zero.
Repeat/release of an accepted press suppressed; selection unchanged.
MODE handling is not ready or disabled.
Test or key learning: stock handling preserved.
Invalid event payload; stock handling preserved.
Not an ordered broadcast; cannot safely replace the stock menu.
Broadcast forbids aborting delivery; stock handling preserved.
Overlay permission missing; stock handling preserved.
Not a fresh key-down; our menu was not advanced.
Menu or delivery-abort error; our selection cancelled. See log.
MODE background service / diagnostics. Tap to open settings.
Accessibility: cannot read system permission state; see log.
Accessibility: system permission enabled, service connected.
Accessibility: system permission enabled, but service disconnected. Android controls reconnection; see log. HCN can work independently.
Accessibility: system permission disabled or removed. CarMode cannot grant it automatically. HCN does not require it.

On Android 10, startup uses BOOT_COMPLETED; there is no standard approval dialog. The head unit may have its own auto-start/background whitelist: allow CarMode there manually. Swiping Recents does not stop our background service. Force stop and firmware process killing may prevent restart. HCN needs Overlay, not Accessibility.
This directly launches the app for this card. Volume and other apps are not changed.
App %1$s is not installed or has no available launcher. Assign an app in the card settings.

Finds installed com.zjinnova.zlink. Copy saves its APK to Downloads; Share sends a read-only cache copy to an app you choose. Split APKs are packed into one ZIP. No private app data is copied; ZLink is not modified.
com.zjinnova.zlink was not found or is not visible on this device.
Saved to Downloads: %1$s. Repeated copies may have a numbered filename.

Legacy tools: Accessibility key learning, marked MODE/keyboard tests, detailed logs and stock MODE APK export. They remain available for investigation, but HCN MODE does not need them. MacroDroid integration was removed in 0.1.9; no ADB shell commands are executed here.
Copy factory settings APK to Downloads

Choose the installed app that opens Factory settings. Factory / Car Settings / Settings candidates are shown first, followed by all other visible apps, including system apps. Package names are shown; candidates are not confirmed matches. Copies only APK files, not private data or vehicle settings. Multiple APK parts are packed into ZIP.
No installed apps are visible for export.
Saved to Downloads: %1$s. Repeated copies may have a numbered filename.
Optional startup through the Home screen

Choose CarMode as Android Home. It requests MODE background startup, then immediately opens your original launcher. No OEM APK is modified. This affects Home presses as well as boot, and may be blocked by firmware. Keep auto-start, HCN and Overlay enabled. Factory Startup Application is unrelated.
Home settings: restore the original launcher

Android will ask you to select CarMode Bridge as your Home app. CarMode forwards Home to com.android.launcher3.Launcher after requesting background startup. To undo, open Home settings and choose the original Launcher, not CarMode. Proceed?
Original com.android.launcher3.Launcher is unavailable. Home proxy selection is not offered on this device.
CarMode could not open the original launcher. Choose another Home app in Android settings, or open CarMode settings below. No implicit Home retry is performed.
Android Home settings are unavailable on this firmware.
Send music HTTP request after launch

Optional GET 1.2 seconds after launching the Music app. Off by default. The initial address comes from Music.macro; verify that your phone server is running and the address is current. Camera, maps and boot do not send it. No retries or redirects. Switching off cancels an unsent request, not one already sent. HTTP is unencrypted; use a trusted network. Server availability and playback are not guaranteed.
Enter an HTTP(S) URL without embedded credentials or a fragment.

Enables Camry Home and window mode. Once per Android boot, opens the selected camera app in Home first. If Android Auto startup is also enabled, requests ZLink 1.5 seconds later. This is a fixed delay, not a readiness check. Disables the separate camera-return observer.
Cannot open this app. Check its assignment and availability.
Android Auto app is unavailable. Select ZLink in CarMode settings.
Could not save the rollback. Keep CarMode installed and choose the stock launcher in Android settings.
CarMode recovery · return to the original launcher
Android Home is now the stock Launcher3.
Stock Launcher3 is not selected as Android Home. Select it before removing CarMode.
Camry Home remains off: the stock launcher or Android Home settings are unavailable.
Enable manual Dock sessions in CarMode settings first.

Dock can cover part of another app. In Camry mode it appears after camera launches through CarMode and when ZLink covers Home. A camera activated directly by the vehicle may not notify CarMode. Screen-off closes the session.
Dock is active. Use Close Dock to dismiss it.

Choose CarMode as Android Home separately using the existing Home selector. Five Back presses within 5 seconds on CarMode screens restore OEM forwarding and turn off Dock and ZLink startup, preserving MODE. Re-enable new features manually. To uninstall, also select Launcher3 as Android Home. Automatic boot startup attempts ZLink at most once per Android boot; if boot identity is unavailable, no further automatic attempt is made. In Camry mode Dock also appears after camera launches through CarMode and when ZLink covers Home.

ZLink opens automatically when you enter Home in window mode. Tap its area to retry if needed. The head unit may ignore the window size and launch ZLink normally. You can switch this mode off directly in Home. Close an existing ZLink window and reopen it to apply the new area size.
Window launch unavailable. Trying a normal ZLink launch.
Home layout is not ready. Tap the ZLink area to try again.
Enables Camry Home and window mode. ZLink launches through CarMode Apps, MODE and Dock go to Home. Independent ZLink auto-connect and window bounds depend on head-unit firmware.
ZLink repeatedly opened fullscreen. Automatic correction paused to avoid a launch loop. Toggle ZLink only in Home off and on to retry.
Opens apps launched through CarMode in the Home area. Enables Camry Home and window mode. Other apps and the system may still open fullscreen or ignore the requested size.
Return Home after first boot-time camera launch

During the first two minutes after Android boots, return to Home with ZLink once when cameras appear. Requires Usage access and overlay permission. Cannot distinguish automatic startup from reverse gear. Opening cameras through CarMode cancels this return for the current boot.
Allow Usage access for CarMode Bridge
Usage access allowed — open permission settings
Usage access settings are unavailable on this device.
App unavailable. Hold to remove or move its shortcut.
Allow display over other apps to show the shortcut trash above ZLink.
Saved MODE event ignored; no new press
